name: FlightGear
description: The primary FlightGear updater is a HTTPS notification/check path and does not establish an in-app self-update-to-executable flow. A separate aircraft package channel uses HTTP catalogs and same-catalog MD5, so the original undifferentiated primary D label should be corrected to N for primary update with a qualified data/content finding.
limitations: Review is limited to the retained commit; it does not certify released artifacts or current upstream behavior.
